summary: Extracted build-gate and run-journal logic from agent-executor into new modules (src/goal/build-gate.ts and src/goal/run-journal.ts), updated agent-executor imports/call sites, and added a small helper-module extraction (src/goal/agent-executor-helpers.ts) to keep agent-executor.ts under 1100 LOC (now 1078) without behavior changes. Verified with pnpm build, pnpm vitest run src/goal/agent-executor.test.ts, and pnpm lint on changed files.
